title: Transaction Foundation Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Financial Transaction Data: A Comparative Evaluation with Text Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.28641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain-specific tabular and transaction foundation models are increasingly proposed as drop-in representation learners for financial applications, but their value relative to off-the-shelf text embedding models for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over structured data remains underexamined. We construct a deterministic, template-generated question-answering benchmark of 1,026 questions with retrieval-level gold-document annotations over IBM's synthetic Anti-Money-Laundering (AML) transaction dataset, and compare NVIDIA's 29M-parameter Transaction Foundation Model (TFM) against five general-purpose and financial-domain text embedding models under a size- and data-matched retrieval setup, as well as against a hand-aggregated summary-text baseline. translated_abstract: 面向特定领域的表格与交易基础模型日益被提出作为金融应用的即插即用表示学习器，但相对于现成的文本嵌入模型，它们在结构化数据检索增强生成（RAG）中的价值仍未得到充分检验。我们在IBM的合成反洗钱（AML）交易数据集上构建了一个确定性的、由模板生成的问答基准，包含1,026个问题并带有检索级别的金标准文档标注，并在大小和数据匹配的检索设置下，将NVIDIA的2900万参数交易基础模型（TFM）与五个通用及金融领域的文本嵌入模型进行比较，同时与人工聚合的摘要文本基线进行对比。TFM在检索性能（Recall@5：0.81 对比 0.25-0.39）和端到端答案准确率（66.7% 对比 27.5%）方面均显著优于所有大小匹配的通用嵌入模型。然而，一个简单的流水线……
tldr: 本研究在IBM合成反洗钱交易数据集上构建了1,026个问题的问答基准，证明NVIDIA的2900万参数交易基础模型（TFM）在金融交易数据检索增强生成任务中的检索性能和端到端答案准确率均大幅超越同规模的通用文本嵌入模型。
en_tdlr: Using a 1,026-question benchmark built on IBM's synthetic AML transaction dataset, this study demonstrates that NVIDIA's 29M-parameter Transaction Foundation Model (TFM) substantially outperforms size-matched generic text embeddings in both retrieval and end-to-end answer accuracy for RAG over financial transaction data.
